constraints.text: Maximise what judges see working: D1–D5 run end to end from the cockpit in `LLM_MODE=replay`, with the canonical facts in CLAUDE.md (D1 ₹2,499 reversal plus ₹200 compensation, D3 ₹12,000 to NEEDS_APPROVAL, D2 AXIS/UPI_SWITCH_DOWN threshold 10 in 60 min).
One-day build. The run implements only T4–T27 of docs/06 in 06 order, minus the non-goals. Nothing beyond 06's file lists.

The LLM never moves money. Model output is a `Decision`; every proposed action passes `app/policy/engine.py` and executes only through `ToolRegistry.call()` after `AUTO_EXECUTE` or a human approval (CLAUDE.md hard rule 1).
Enums, ids, table and column names, routes, file paths, env vars and action names are exactly as in docs/02. New fields are marked `(decision: …)` (hard rule 3).
Every action execution computes `sha256(ticket_id + name + canonical params)` and checks `action_executions` first; a retry never double-refunds (hard rule 5).
LLM calls use `temperature=0`, structured output via tool-use and `max_tokens` ≤ 1500. Prompts live in `app/agent/prompts/*.md` (hard rule 8).
`LLM_MODE=mock` with the mounted mock Paytm runs the 7 scenarios with no network, and no test depends on the Anthropic API (hard rule 11).
SQLite via `create_all`/`reset` only. No migrations, no Postgres, no Celery or external queue, no services beyond the docs/02 §2 layout.
Demo inputs are deterministic (fixed scenario ids, seeded `random.Random` for spike and eval data), so replay-cache keys match on stage (pre-mortem: users).
During a 120-ticket spike, incident-matched tickets make 0 LLM calls and `/api/health` answers in < 300 ms (pre-mortem: system).

The agent loop is the docs/02 §3 LangGraph `StateGraph` in `agent/graph.py`, and `AGENT_ENGINE=langgraph|runner` selects it or the sequential `agent/runner.py` fallback over the same pure nodes and §3.2 edges; both engines run the 7 scenarios in mock mode (D5, D9).
No call to a real Paytm endpoint. `PAYTM_BASE_URL` points at `/mock/paytm/v1` or the standalone mock on `:8001`; any other value is refused (hard rule 2).
PII is masked by `app/policy/pii.py` before any LLM call. The UI shows `masked_text` by default, and raw phone, email, VPA or account numbers are never logged (hard rule 6).
No `eval()` or `exec()` anywhere, including the rules expression evaluator (hard rule 7).
The gate resolves `txn/refund/settlement/kyc/mandate` ids only from the `ContextBundle`; anything else is `BLOCKED unknown_reference` (hard rule 9).
Every tool call writes `tool_call` and `tool_result`, every node writes its docs/02 §3.2 audit kind, and approvals, overrides, notifications and incident links are audited with `actor` (hard rule 4).
Each task stays inside its file list. No refactors, renames, dependency swaps or "while I'm here" changes (hard rule 10, D1).

Every acceptance check runs in-process from the repo root of an isolated clone, with no running server, no shell and no calls to Anthropic or Paytm (package installs by `uv` and `npm ci` are allowed). It names its test file (never `-k`), and tests pin `LLM_MODE=mock` themselves (pre-mortem: build/run).
The cockpit is projected. Large badges and numbers readable at 3 m, Tailwind only, palette navy #002E6E, cyan #00BAF2, light #F2F6FB, text #0B1F3A (D4).
Every cockpit page polls with `useSWR` `refreshInterval: 2000`, so a backend state change shows within 2 s.
